inputs.original_text: This seems less like an explanation about public safety and more like a coordinated effort to use one arrest as cover for expanding federal power. DHS is framing it as “sanctuary versus public safety” to make harsher enforcement seem inevitable while keeping the fuller picture out of view. The timing and emphasis appear deliberate—part of how institutions manufacture consent.
